messages:
andrew: Proposal: split ingress retry behavior into two orthogonal mechanisms: (1) fast-path hedging at the gateway for sub-250ms transient stalls (non-durable) to keep p99 latency down; (2) durable server-side retries that persist across client stream reconnects and are tracked by an idempotency/operation token. RFC follow-up — need agreement on interfaces, ownership, and failure modes.

jin: +1 on separation. quick Q: who owns the op-token lifecycle and generation? edge or upstream?

maria: my take — edge generates a short opaque token per logical request (hash of path+payload + random nonce) and forwards as header `X-Op-Token`. upstreams can persist a tiny retry record keyed by token. pros: edge stays stateless; cons: storage + GC.

sam: important: for streaming (partial frames) durable retries only safe when upstream supports resume or op is idempotent. otherwise durable retries risk duplicate side-effects. default durable-mode = off for side-effecting routes.

claire: we also need a reconnect/TTL policy. options: keep durable retry record alive for short TTL (30–60s) for quick reconnects, or allow longer (minutes) for mobile flakiness. tradeoff: backend resource holding vs UX.

andrew: rough API sketch: headers `X-Op-Token`, `X-Op-Retry-Mode: fast|durable`, `X-Op-Resume-Offset` (optional). sample ingress config: 

```json
{"ingress.retry.fast_hedge_ms":200, "ingress.retry.durable_ttl_s":60, "ingress.retry.max_durable_attempts":3}
```

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rolling edge config v17 to canary 10% with `fast_hedge_ms=150` :rocket:

luca: side-effects checklist: DB writes, external webhooks, downstream notifications — durable retries should be opt-in per-route. add annotation `redwood.retryable=true` to model/service metadata.

maria: small security nit: if edge generates tokens, don't put raw payload in token. use HMAC(key, payload-hash + nonce) so token is verifiable but not PII-leaking.

sam: another heuristic: hedging/backpressure budget per-upstream. don't spawn hedges if upstream concurrency near limit; add `hedge_budget` that decays on failures.

andrew: action items: andrew -> draft RFC w/ state diagram and header contract; jin -> storage & cost estimate for durable records; luca -> side-effect policy draft; sam -> hedging budget algorithm. I'll include perf targets for p50/p99 and expected resource delta. :thumbsup:
